title: Controlling Kotlin's Java-Facing API
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of controlling kotlin's java-facing api using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates controlling kotlin's java-facing api.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Controlling Kotlin's Java-Facing API** as part of **Kotlin and Java Interoperability**. Kotlin and Java interoperate, but platform types, annotations, generated JVM signatures, and collection mutability require explicit boundary checks. Use the subtopics—@JvmStatic, @JvmOverloads, @JvmField and @JvmName—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Real projects depend on reliable error handling, modular organization, reproducible builds, and safe language boundaries. This lesson helps turn isolated syntax into maintainable applications.
